listenings.text: Good evening, and welcome to the Blue Door. Before you order, let me tell you about tonight. The soup of the day is tomato with fresh bread, and it is very good tonight. The fish of the day is salmon, from this morning. And I have to say one thing about the steak: it takes twenty-five minutes, so if you would like the steak, please tell me now and not later. We have red and white wine by the glass, and the water is small or big. One more thing. The kitchen closes at ten thirty, so if you would like a dessert, order it with the main dish. Take your time. I come back in five minutes.

Hey, it's me. You asked me about a restaurant near the hotel, so here it is. The place is called the Blue Door, on Market Street, five minutes on foot. It is small, about ten tables, and it is always full at eight, so book a table. The food is simple and it is very good. I had the fish and it was excellent. Two things to know. First, they are closed on Mondays, and I forgot that last time and walked there for nothing. Second, service is not in the bill, so leave something on the table. Ask for a table near the window. That is the best part of the restaurant. Call me later and tell me what you think.

extra_audio.text: Good evening. A table for two, please. Can I have the menu, please? I would like the fish, please. And a big water, please. Excuse me, could I have the bill, please? Thank you very much.
